title: 第24章 待会一定让你好看
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
陆瑶不知道什么时候走到了陈默面前，她的脸上带着嘲讽的笑容眼中也全是不屑。

    然而陈默只是看了她一眼然后收回了目光，脸上没有什么表情。

    “我跟你说话呢你聋了是不是。”陆瑶说道。

    “你之前侥幸打败了我哥那纯粹是你运气好而已，要不是你掌握了上品法术你根本不是我哥的对手，也不知道你有什么好得意的。”

    可陈默却没有说话甚至连看都没看她一眼，只见陆瑶的脸色变得难看起来。

    “我告诉你昨天夜里大长老已经传授给我哥一门上品法术，以我哥金丹大圆满的修为配上上品法术你根本不是他的对手。”

    “今天你就等着受死吧。”

    然而陈默依然没有说话，他的目光落在擂台上看着那两个弟子在比试。

    当陆瑶看到他这副态度以后心中的怒火一下子就点燃了起来，她在心里想着这个陈默凭什么无视她。

    “我说话你听到没有。”

    旁边的周玄看到这一幕心中有些紧张，他拉了拉陈默的衣袖想让他说句话。

    可陈默还是没有任何反应，陆瑶气得浑身发抖脸都涨红了。

    “陈默你别以为你不说话就没事了，等我哥晋级内门之后想要处死你就是一句话的事情。”

    “到时候你跪下来求我都没用，我一定会让我哥亲手宰了你。”

    这时陈默终于转过头看了她一眼，那眼神很平静没有任何波澜。

    “说完了吗？说完了就滚一边去别在这里碍眼。”

    一听这话陆瑶的脸色当场就变了，她的嘴唇都在发抖眼中充满了愤怒。

    “你……你敢让我滚，陈默你算什么东西一个废物也敢让我滚。”

    “你信不信我现在就让我哥过来收拾你。”

    “你要叫就赶紧叫不然就滚。”

    此时陆瑶已经被气得说不出话来，她的手紧紧攥着整个人都在发抖。

    这个陈默凭什么这么嚣张一个废物而已哪来的底气。

    “陈默你给我等着，等我哥上台之后看他怎么收拾你。”说完之后陆瑶转身就走。

    当周玄看着陆瑶离开的背影以后立刻转过头看着陈默，他的脸上带着几分担忧。
content_en:
Lu Yao didn't know when she walked up to Chen Mo, with a mocking smile on her face and disdain in her eyes.

    However, Chen Mo just glanced at her and then looked away, with no expression on his face.

    "I'm talking to you, are you deaf?" Lu Yao said.

    "The fact that you defeated my brother by chance before was purely due to your luck. If you hadn't mastered the top-grade spells, you wouldn't be my brother's opponent at all. I don't know what you would be proud of."

    But Chen Mo didn't say anything or even look at her. Lu Yao's face turned ugly.

    "Let me tell you that the great elder taught my brother a high-grade spell last night. With my brother's golden elixir perfection and the high-grade spell, you are no match for him."

    "You are just waiting to die today."

    However, Chen Mo still didn't speak. His eyes fell on the ring and watched the two disciples competing.

    When Lu Yao saw his attitude, the anger in her heart suddenly ignited, and she thought in her heart why Chen Mo ignored her.

    "Did you hear what I said?"

    Zhou Xuan, who was next to him, felt a little nervous when he saw this scene. He pulled Chen Mo's sleeve and wanted him to say something.

    But Chen Mo still didn't respond, and Lu Yao was so angry that she was shaking all over and her face was red.

    "Chen Mo, don't think that it will be fine if you don't speak. When my brother is promoted to the inner sect, it will only take one sentence to execute you."

    "When the time comes, it will be useless for you to kneel down and beg me. I will definitely let my brother kill you with his own hands."

    At this time, Chen Mo finally turned his head and glanced at her, his eyes were calm and without any disturbance.

    "Are you done? Once you're done, get out of here and don't be an eyesore here."

    Lu Yao's face changed immediately upon hearing this, her lips were trembling and her eyes were full of anger.

    "You...you dare to tell me to leave. Chen Mo, who are you and a loser? How dare you tell me to leave."

    "Believe it or not, I will ask my brother to come over and take care of you right now."

    "If you want to scream, scream quickly or get out."

    At this time, Lu Yao was so angry that she couldn't speak. She held her hands tightly and her whole body was shaking.

    Why is this Chen Mo so arrogant? How can he have the confidence to act like a loser?

    "Chen Mo, just wait for me. Let's see how he deals with you when my brother comes on stage." After saying that, Lu Yao turned around and left.

    When Zhou Xuan looked at Lu Yao's leaving figure, he immediately turned to look at Chen Mo, with a bit of worry on his face.
title_en: Chapter 24 I will make you look good later
